excerpts:
# Columbia Pictures Announces Title of the Next ‘Spider-Man’ Film
## [Pamela McClintock](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/author/pamela-mcclintock/)
### More Stories by Pamela
Columbia Pictures has settled on a name for the next installment in its blockbuster superhero franchise: _The Amazing Spider-Man_ .
Film stars **Andrew Garfield** , and hits theaters July 3, 2012.
Columbia also has released a photo of Garfield as Spider-Man, the first shot of him in the famous full mask and suit.
